title: agent-orchestrator guardrail policy document
description: Schema for a single guardrail policy document (guardrails/policy, issue #26). A bundle file may hold one policy at the top level or a 'policies:' container whose elements must each conform to this schema. Startup validation checks every document against this schema so an invalid policy fails the deploy, never at runtime.

id.description: Stable policy slug, unique within a bundle (duplicates are rejected by the assembler).

default.description: Decision contributed when the policy governs an action but no rule fires. Defaults to 'log'.

controls.description: Control ids that must all be ACTIVE for the policy to be enforced (flag-gated OFF doctrine, AO-GR-6). Referencing an unregistered control is a startup-validation error.

id.description: Rule slug, unique within its policy.

actions.description: Action glob patterns this rule governs (e.g. model.call, tool.use, egress.send).

decision.description: Decision emitted when the rule fires.

reason.description: Audit explanation. A BLOCK rule MUST carry one (a block without an explanation is unauditable and rejected by semantic validation).

subjects.description: Optional subject globs; empty means any subject.

tenants.description: Optional tenant globs; empty means any tenant.

condition.description: Predicate tree consumed by policy.conditions (all/any/not + {path,op,value} leaves). Structure and operators are validated semantically at startup.
